name: Deepgram
description: Read-only Deepgram access: the account's projects and the speech-to-text models available to them. Deepgram's transcription endpoint (/v1/listen) is billable and needs an audio payload/URL, so it is deliberately out of scope here rather than modelled write:true with nothing real to send; this connector completes STT coverage alongside AssemblyAI as a read-only pair.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the Deepgram projects this API key belongs to, with their id, name and account balance company

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the speech-to-text and text-to-speech models Deepgram currently offers, with their name, version and languages

_scaffold.source: hand-authored 2026-09-16, frontier-LLM gap fill batch B (project_ai_tools_coverage_gaps_2026_09_16)
needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real Deepgram API key against /v1/projects, a zero-spend authed read per the coverage-gap plan.

NEW VAULT TYPE: 'deepgram' did not exist in integrationTypeRegistry.js before this build (single api_key field, Authorization: Token <key> header, live testEndpoint /v1/projects). Added alongside this connector.
Auth uses the 'Token' scheme, not 'Bearer' — Deepgram's own documented convention (Authorization: Token <api_key>).

No write tool is declared. /v1/listen (transcription) is billable and requires a real audio URL or upload, which the shape-proof harness cannot supply blind and which would be a poor fit for a dummy-input HITL probe; deliberately left out rather than modelled with nothing real to send.

SHAPE-PROOF FINDING (2026-09-16 run, real network, dummy key): GET /v1/models answered 200 with a real, unauthenticated stt[]/tts[] catalogue (public_endpoint) -- Deepgram serves its model list keyless, unlike /v1/projects which correctly 401s a dummy key. Both the response shape (stt[]/tts[]) and the pick paths are confirmed correct against the live body.
